data.title: The Journey of the Monarch Butterfly
data.description: A monarch butterfly undergoes complete metamorphosis, moving through four distinct life stages with specific survival needs and structures at each stage.

item.prompt: Put the four stages of the monarch butterfly's life cycle in order from start to finish.

rows: Insects change their body forms completely as they grow from young to mature adults.

misconceptions.butterfly: Adult butterflies come at the end of the life cycle after metamorphosis, not at the beginning.
misconceptions.chrysalis: A chrysalis forms after the caterpillar grows; it cannot come directly out of an egg.
